d: Iphigenia and the priests are in prayer for the storm to be calmed
Oresie and Pylade are driven, chained
Enter a minister of the sanctuary and the temple guards
The Eumenids seem to surround Oreste. Some execute around him a pantomine ballet of terror the others speak to him. Oreste remains asleep throughout the whole scene
The doors of the apartment open; the priests appear: the furies get damaged without being able to be seen
Iphigénie lies alone at the feet of the statue
Pylade entered quickly, followed by a group of Greeks
The goddess Diane descends into a cloud in the midst of the fighters
